slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Proofs about "greater than" use the properties of inequality. If a > b, then a + c > b + c and a − c > b − c. If a > b and c > 0, then ac > bc; if c < 0 the inequality flips. Transitive: if a > b and b > c, then a > c.

The key geometric one: if c = a + b and b > 0, then c > a. The whole is greater than any of its parts. So if point D is inside angle ABC, then m angle ABC > m angle ABD.
